en: A sepia-toned historical postcard showing a grand spa theater complex. On the left is a multi‑story building labeled "Sachsenhof" with many windows and balconies. In the center is a neoclassical building with four large columns and a pediment, labeled "Kurtheater." Several people in early 20th‑century clothing stroll in the open square and paths in front of the buildings, which are surrounded by trees.
